question: Why did the error rate go up on 26 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of checkout v3.17 caused the error rate to spike.
why_chain: Checkout v3.17 deployment introduced a new version of the RequestHandler.
NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) led to increased error rate.
Error rate rose from 0.53% to 3.54% on 26 March 2026.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was due to a sudden surge in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume and p95 latency remained stable before and after the change.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was caused by a configuration change.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a config change leading to the error rate increase.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The error rate increase was due to a dependency issue with an external service.
ruled_out.reason: No evidence supports a dependency issue leading to the error rate increase.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service checkout in region ap-south rose from 0.53% to 3.54% (+571%), with a change point at 2026-03-26T06:10:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service checkout in region ap-south: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.05).
At the same time, request volume for service checkout in region ap-south stayed about the same (168 per 5 min before, 198 per 5 min after, +18%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service checkout in region ap-south stayed about the same (221 ms before, 220 ms after, -0%).
Deployed checkout v3.17 to ap-south (checkout, ap-south; 2 min before the change; record R010)
High error rate on checkout in ap-south (checkout, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R011)
checkout: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) (checkout, ap-south; 10 min after the change; record R012)
checkout: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) (checkout, ap-south; 28 min after the change; record R013)
checkout: ERROR NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) (checkout, ap-south; 36 min after the change; record R014)

reasons: ✓ A change event (deploys) lines up in time (2 min before the change).
✓ 4 log/alert record(s) after the change agree with the numbers.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.

actions.action: Fix the NullPointerException in RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) in checkout v3.17.
Monitor and log RequestHandler.serialize (v3.17) for any future occurrences.
Review and test the new checkout v3.17 in a staging environment before production deployment.
